author: Heatvent
releaseNotes:
v2.1.1 - Tone labels drop the length (the ZSE50 reports lengths inaccurately).
v2.1.0 - Readable Play Sound list ("10 - Buzzer Alarm") read from the device's tone files; custom MP3s named from their file names; refreshTones command; Chime status attribute; ping(); commands accept numbers sent as text.
v2.0.0 - Full Zooz parameter map (1-16), S2 zwaveSecureEncap, Chime/Alarm/strobe, playSound, setVolume, LED color, association group 2, fingerprints. Corrects prior local driver that mis-mapped params 1-3.
